text: Hello everyone, welcome to Zoe's class, glad to see you again.Today we will go over modal verbs, 情態動詞。These are what you are expected to learn in today's lesson.Please get your worksheet and notebook ready.Look at the picture, where are they?Yes, in a hotel.Look, there is a bell boy, 門童。What is the bell boy saying?A or B, why?Yes, sentence B shows the bell boy's politeness because he uses the modal verb, could.The situation decides the language we use to communicate.Here, using a modal verb is more suitable.How many modal verbs have we learned?Make a list on your worksheet, task one.Ready, go.OK, have you got all of them?Today we will review the usages of some of them.Please listen to the recordings and answer this question.What's the relationship between the two speakers?Open wide, now show me where it hurts.Here, at the bottom, especially when I bite something hot or cold.You should come here to have your teeth checked twice a year.OK, I will.What does the man do?Yes, a dentist.Which sentence helps you know that?Listen again and try to catch the keywords or phrases.What did the dentist say?The dentist uses should to give suggestions.Sir, I have no idea why you stopped me.Driver's license, madam.You mustn't drive over 60 km per hour on this road.I'm sorry.What's the relationship between them?Yes, a policeman and a driver.Which modal verb did he use?Listen again.The policeman uses mustn't to give warnings.As a policeman, it's his duty to warn drivers not to break the traffic rules.Three.Can I leave a bit earlier today, Mr.Brown?What's the matter?My mom will go to America this afternoon.She will work there for quite a long time, so my family wants to see her off.All right.What is Mr.Now listen again.Perhaps Mr.Brown is a boss or a teacher.When you ask your boss or teacher for an early leave, you'd better use can I?So what can you get from these conversations?Yes, when you talk with different people, you use modal verbs to help people understand your feelings and attitudes.Have a try.Please make two dialogues by using modal verbs.Task 2 on your worksheet.Ready?这里是我的学生谈论,只是为了您的参考。如果您喜欢我的视频,欢迎订阅我的频道。我可以帮助你吗?请帮我展示这个。妈妈,我可以吃饼子了吗?不,我怕你不可以。你应该先洗手。人们在不同情况下使用模特儿词。您可以与合作伙伴分享你的文章,并练习用他的或她的课程。我还有三个谈论,他们比较困难。订阅它们,并告诉我您可以用哪些谈论。完成三个谈论在你的课程中。时间到了,让我们检查一下。一,您选择哪个?是的,B是正确的。您知道哪个词吗?我等不及。它显示他不开心或忐忑。您可以读读谈论,并展示男人的感受吗?哦,太好了!让我邀请Molly和Ludkin来读读我们的课程。Johnson,您在附近吃晚饭后怎么办?我们可以知道他真的想拿着一些东西来吃。二,在第二个谈论中,我们知道男人不愿意回家煮晚饭。在这里,必须和必须展示。试试用情绪读读。我们去旁边的厨房喝点饮料吗?对不起,我必须回家。今天我必须煮晚饭。在第三个谈论中,我们可以读出女人不能处理情况。她不知道该怎么办。您找到哪些模特词?可以和应该帮助我们知道她感到无助。您可以读出自己的谈论吗?您感到无助和担心吗?我失去了我的键。我们不能进去。我们该怎么办?所以,模特词可以帮助我们更好地知道主持人的感受,态度,或甚至他们的性格。我们很常听到人们用模特词在谈论中,如果您关注他们的说话。我们可以用模特词在这种情况下吗?选择一个情况,并使用模特词进行谈论。这就是您的课程第四项。【在这里,】sickHere are my students' dialogues as examples for you.Situation OneTwo of your good friends, Judy and Robin are arguing.Listen.How could you say that to me?You play me first.Hey guys, would you please calm down and listen to me now?You need them to solve this problem right now.We can talk about it after school.Okay?Fine.Situation 2.Your classmate left his English book at home.Oh, I left my English book at home.May I look at your book in the class?Sure, you should remember to take it every day.Yes, I will.Thank you, Molly and Lutkin.You can hear students also use modal verbs at school quite often.Where else do people use modal verbs?We usually see different kinds of signs around us.Let me take these five as an example.They may be found in a big supermarket.Do you know what they are?Draw quickly in the boxes and introduce what these signs mean.Please fill in the blanks.Finish task 5 on your worksheet.Off you go.Okay, let's check.Sign 1 means we can park our car here.Sign 2 means we must turn left.Sign 4 means we must turn right.Sign 3 means we mustn't smoke here.Sign 4 means we can go out here.Sign 5 means we should or ought to pay attention to the wet floor.Have you got all the answers right?Great!When we talk about signs or rules, we can use modal verbs to tell others what they must or mustn't do, what they can do, and what they should do.Look at this passage.What is it about?This passage is what the hostess says before the plane takes off.Have you ever heard that?Do you understand?Read it and write some rules by using some modal verbs.Okay, time's up.Let's check.Here is one of the possible answers.We mustn't use the electronic devices during takeoff or landing, but we can use them during the flight.What's your answer?You can share your ideas after class.Next, let's review something you may get confused with.接下来我们复习一下同学们容易混淆的知识点。First of all, I bet it's the use of need, right?need 作为形态动词时表示需要。主要用于否定句和疑问句中。其否定形式为needn't。它还可以做实义动词。此时有人称数和时态的变化。后跟不定是to do或是something。Next, do you know the difference between must and have to?Look at this sentence.We use must and have to to say that it is necessary to do something.We use have to or has to for facts, not for our personal feelings.Three, we use had to or didn't have to for the past of both must and have to.Four, don't or doesn't have to do means don't or doesn't need to do.Complete the sentences with must, mustn't or not have to.One, we couldn't repair the car ourselves.We had to take it to a garage.Two, we mustn't argue with the bus driver.It's too dangerous.Three, he doesn't have to wear a suit to work, but he usually does.We use modal verbs not only in conversation but in writing as well.Here is a topic you are often asked to write about, how to live a healthy life.In this passage writing, you are required to give suggestions by using modal verbs.For example,Eva's tip, we mustn't stay up late.Jerry's idea, we shouldn't watch the screen for too long.I agree.It's your turn to use modal verbs to write some tips.Here are two more examples.Lisa's idea.We need to do exercise regularly.Pause.We can eat some fruits to get vitamins.New term is coming.The class teacher is considering making some class rules.For example,We should listen when others are talking.We mustn't eat or drink when we are having a lesson.Can you add more rules?It's task 8 on your worksheet.Two more ideas for your reference.We must work and play in a safe manner.We can't disturb others.I'm sure you have better ideas.This term, my student Annie is going to have an education class.She is going to have an educational visit to Britain.But she has no idea how to get along with British studentsand how to stay with the host family.She is so worried.She'd like to ask the host family some questions before she gets there.For example,Question 1.How can I get along with British students?Could I use the washing machine?Would you please help her raise some questions?Thank you for your help.You can discuss with your classmates after this class.今天我们进一步理解了情态动词的意义和在不同的语境下的用法复习的重点是围绕话题正确运用情态动词进行交流和表达不同的情态动词能反映人物的不同身份、情感、态度、甚至是性格很有趣吧?
